name: o11y-analysis-tools
description: PromQL-Cody: Agent Skills for the o11y-analysis-tools PromQL/Alertmanager CLIs (promql-fmt, label-check, autogen-promql-tests, e2e-alertmanager-test, alert-hysteresis, stale-alerts-analyzer)

plugins.name: promql-fmt
plugins.description: Format/lint PromQL expressions embedded in Prometheus rule YAML files. Hermetic; safe for CI.

plugins.name: label-check
plugins.description: Enforce required labels on PromQL expressions and alert definitions. Hermetic; safe for CI.

plugins.name: autogen-promql-tests
plugins.description: Scaffold promtool unit-test skeletons for untested Prometheus alert/recording rules. Hermetic.

plugins.name: e2e-alertmanager-test
plugins.description: Render end-to-end alert notification previews (email/Slack/JSON) through a live Alertmanager.

plugins.name: alert-hysteresis
plugins.description: Recommend 'for:' duration tuning from live Prometheus alert-firing history. Interactive.

plugins.name: stale-alerts-analyzer
plugins.description: Flag alert rules that rarely or never fire, using live Prometheus history. Interactive.
